design_changes: Adjacent-event pairs use the same input polarity to test overlapping responses rather than polarity-assisted separation.
semantic_corrections: V2 contributes its own median window lag; it does not estimate onset or centroid.
Gaussian onset is not strict support onset; event/kernel onset is explicitly 5% absolute mass.
posthoc_diagnostic: Constant-background sensitivity was added after poor real-data linear-trend extrapolation; no revised main method selected.
